title: Roasted Aloo Gobi with Chickpeas & Yogurt

ingredients.swap: Leave the yogurt off one plate.

steps.title: Get prepped
steps.text: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Cut the cauliflower into florets and the potatoes into bite-size chunks. Drain the chickpeas, cut the onion into wedges and crush the garlic.

steps.title: Roast the veg
steps.text: Toss the cauliflower, potatoes, chickpeas and onion on a large roasting tray with the oil, curry powder and 1 teaspoon of salt. Spread out and roast for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Add the tomatoes
steps.text: Turn everything over and add the cherry tomatoes and garlic to the tray. Roast for 10 to 15 minutes more until the potatoes are tender, the cauliflower is charred at the edges and the tomatoes have burst. Warm the naans in the oven for the last 2 minutes.

steps.title: Plate up
steps.text: Divide the aloo gobi between plates and serve with the warm naans and a dollop of yogurt.

title: Masala-Crusted Salmon with Bombay Potatoes & Spinach

ingredients.swap: Leave the tomatoes off one plate.

steps.title: Get prepped
steps.text: Cut the potatoes into bite-size cubes, slice the garlic and halve the cherry tomatoes. Mix the tikka paste with 1 tablespoon of the yogurt and spread over the top of the salmon.

steps.title: Par-cook the potatoes
steps.text: Put the potatoes in a microwaveable bowl with a splash of water. Cover and microwave on high for 6 to 7 minutes until just tender, then drain well.

steps.title: Crisp the Bombay potatoes
steps.text: Heat 1½ tablespoons of the oil in a large frying pan over a medium-high heat. Add the potatoes, curry powder and a pinch of salt and fry for 10 minutes, turning, until golden and crisp at the edges.

steps.title: Cook the salmon
steps.text: Meanwhile, heat the remaining oil in a second frying pan over a medium heat. Cook the salmon skin-side down for 4 minutes until crisp, then turn and cook for 3 to 4 minutes more. It's ready when the crust is charred and the salmon flakes easily.

steps.title: Add the spinach
steps.text: Push the potatoes to one side, add the garlic and tomatoes and cook for 2 minutes until softening. Stir in the spinach until just wilted, then season with salt.

steps.title: Plate up
steps.text: Loosen the rest of the yogurt with a splash of water and a pinch of salt. Serve the salmon on the potatoes and spinach with the yogurt, and lemon wedges for squeezing (optional).

title: Sweet Potato, Chickpea & Spinach Coconut Curry

steps.title: Get prepped
steps.text: Boil the kettle. Peel the sweet potato and cut into bite-size chunks. Chop the onion, grate the garlic and drain the chickpeas.

steps.title: Fry the base
steps.text: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over a medium heat. Cook the onion for 6 minutes until soft, then stir in the garlic and curry powder for 1 minute until fragrant.

steps.title: Simmer the curry
steps.text: Add the sweet potato, chickpeas, chopped tomatoes, coconut milk, 100 millilitres of water and a good pinch of salt. Bring to a simmer, cover and cook for 15 minutes until the sweet potato is tender when pierced with a knife.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear. Tip it into a small pan with 300 millilitres of boiling water and a pinch of salt. Cover and cook on the lowest heat for 10 minutes. Turn off the heat and leave covered for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.

steps.title: Finish the curry
steps.text: Stir in the spinach and cook for 2 minutes until wilted and the sauce is thick and creamy. Season to taste.

steps.title: Plate up
steps.text: Divide the rice between bowls and spoon over the curry, with a squeeze of lime (optional).

title: Lamb Kofta Curry with Spinach & Warm Naan

ingredients.t: 1, finely chopped (2 tablespoons kept for the koftas)

steps.title: Prep the ingredients
steps.text: Finely chop the onion and set aside 2 tablespoons for the koftas. Grate the garlic.

steps.title: Make the koftas
steps.text: Put the lamb in a bowl with the 2 tablespoons of onion, a third of the garlic, 1 teaspoon of the curry powder and half a teaspoon of salt. Knead for 1 minute, then roll into 12 walnut-sized balls.

steps.title: Brown the koftas
steps.text: Heat the oil in a deep frying pan over a medium-high heat. Fry the koftas for 5 to 6 minutes, turning, until browned all over. Lift onto a plate, leaving the fat in the pan.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.text: Lower the heat to medium, add the remaining onion and cook for 7 minutes until golden. Stir in the rest of the garlic and the rest of the curry powder for 1 minute. Add the chopped tomatoes and 100ml water.

steps.title: Simmer the koftas
steps.text: Return the koftas to the pan, cover and simmer gently for 12 to 15 minutes until cooked through and the sauce is thick. Stir in the spinach until wilted. Take off the heat, swirl through the yogurt (optional) and season with salt.

steps.title: Warm the naan and serve
steps.text: Warm the naans in a dry frying pan over a medium heat for 1 minute each side. Spoon the kofta curry into bowls and serve with the warm naan.

title: Slow-Simmered Ragù Bolognese with Spaghetti & Parmesan

steps.title: Prep the soffritto
steps.text: Finely dice the onion and carrot as small as you can, so they melt into the sauce. Finely chop the bacon and garlic. Crumble the stock cube into 200ml just-boiled water and stir to dissolve.

steps.title: Soften the base
steps.text: Heat the oil in a large heavy pan or casserole over a medium-low heat. Add the bacon and cook for 3 min until its fat runs. Add the onion, carrot and a pinch of salt and cook gently for 10 min until soft and sweet. Stir in the garlic for the last minute.

steps.title: Brown the mince
steps.text: Turn the heat up to medium-high and add the mince, breaking it up with a wooden spoon. Fry for 6–8 min until no pink is left and it's browning in places – that colour is the flavour. Stir in the tomato purée and cook for 1 min.

steps.title: Simmer the ragù
steps.text: Pour in the milk and bubble for 3 min until almost absorbed – it keeps the meat tender. Add the chopped tomatoes and stock, bring to a bubble, then turn the heat right down. Simmer with the lid ajar for at least 45 min (up to 1½ hr), stirring every 15 min. Add a splash of water if it gets thick; it's ready when glossy with a little oil pooling on top.

steps.title: Cook the spaghetti
steps.text: About 15 min before you want to eat, bring a large pan of salted water to the boil. Cook the pasta according to the pack. Scoop out a mugful of the cooking water, then drain.

steps.title: Toss and serve
steps.text: Tip the pasta into the ragù with a splash of the cooking water. Toss over the heat for 1 min until every strand is coated. Season with salt and pepper and serve with the parmesan grated over.

title: Genovese-Style Pesto Pasta with Potatoes & Broccoli

ingredients.t: 1 medium, peeled and cut into 1cm cubes

steps.title: Prep the veg
steps.text: Boil a full kettle. Peel the potato and cut it into 1cm cubes. Cut the broccoli into small florets and thinly slice the stalk. Grate the parmesan.

steps.title: Cook potato and pasta
steps.text: Pour the boiled water into a large pan, salt it well and bring back to the boil over a high heat. Add the potato and pasta together and cook for the pasta's pack time.

steps.title: Add the broccoli
steps.text: 4 minutes before the end of the cooking time, drop the broccoli into the same pan. Everything should be ready together: pasta just tender, broccoli soft and potato starting to break up.

steps.title: Toss with the pesto
steps.text: Scoop out a mugful of the cooking water, then drain. Return everything to the pan off the heat with the pesto, half the parmesan and a good splash of the water. Toss hard for 1 minute, as the potato starch makes the pesto creamy. Add more water if it looks dry.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Season with black pepper and divide between bowls. Finish with the rest of the parmesan.

title: One-Pan Lemon & Garlic Chicken Orzo with Spinach & Parmesan

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Dissolve the stock cube in 500ml just-boiled water. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and season with salt, pepper and the dried herbs (optional). Finely chop the onion and garlic. Zest the lemon and cut it in half.

steps.title: Sear the chicken
steps.text: Heat the oil in a large deep frying pan with a lid over a medium-high heat. Fry the chicken in a single layer for 5–6 min, turning once, until golden. It doesn't need to be cooked through yet, so transfer it to a plate.

steps.title: Toast the orzo
steps.text: Turn the heat to medium and add the butter and onion. Cook for 3 min until soft, then add the garlic for 1 min. Tip in the orzo and stir for 1–2 min until lightly toasted and smelling nutty.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Pour in the stock with the lemon zest, scraping up any browned bits. Return the chicken and its juices, bring to a simmer, cover and cook for 10–12 min. Stir every few minutes until the orzo is tender and the chicken is cooked through with no pink.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Take off the heat and stir in the spinach until wilted, then the parmesan and lemon juice to taste. It should be loose and creamy like a risotto – add a splash of hot water if it's too thick. Serve with plenty of black pepper.

title: Creamy Tuscan Chicken with Crushed Potatoes

ingredients.t: 6 pieces, sliced, plus 1 tablespoon of their oil
ingredients.swap: Leave the sun-dried tomatoes out of the sauce; warm them in a small pan with a little of their oil and spoon over one plate only.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Boil a full kettle. Cut the potatoes into 3cm chunks, skins on. Halve each chicken breast horizontally into 2 thin fillets and season with salt and pepper. Slice the garlic and the sun-dried tomatoes, and dissolve the half stock cube in 100ml just-boiled water.

steps.title: Boil the potatoes
steps.text: Tip the potatoes into a pan, cover with boiling water from the kettle and add a pinch of salt. Cook over a medium-high heat for 15 to 18 minutes until a knife slides in easily.

steps.title: Fry the chicken
steps.text: While the potatoes cook, heat the oil and 1 tablespoon of oil from the sun-dried tomato jar in a large frying pan over a medium-high heat. Fry the chicken for 3 to 4 minutes each side until golden and cooked through with no pink. Rest on a plate.

steps.title: Make the Tuscan sauce
steps.text: Turn the heat to medium and fry the garlic and sun-dried tomatoes for 1 minute. Pour in the stock and scrape up the browned bits. Add the cream and simmer for 3 minutes until it coats the back of a spoon.

steps.title: Add spinach and chicken
steps.text: Stir in the parmesan and spinach until the spinach wilts. Return the chicken and its juices and spoon the sauce over for 2 minutes to warm through.

steps.title: Crush potatoes and serve
steps.text: Drain the potatoes and return them to the pan with the butter and a pinch of salt. Roughly crush with a fork. Plate up with the chicken and plenty of the creamy sauce.

title: Hearty Minestrone with Cannellini Beans & Pasta

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Dissolve the stock cubes in 1 litre of boiling water. Dice the onion, carrot and courgette into roughly 1cm pieces and chop the garlic. Drain and rinse the beans and grate the parmesan.

steps.title: Sweat the veg
steps.text: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over a medium heat. Cook the onion and carrot with a pinch of salt for 8 minutes until softened. Add the courgette, garlic and mixed herbs (optional) for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer the soup
steps.text: Stir in the tomato purée for 1 minute, then add the chopped tomatoes, stock and beans. Bring to the boil, then simmer partly covered for 15 minutes until the carrots are tender. Heat the oven for the baguette now, following the pack.

steps.title: Cook the pasta
steps.text: Stir in the pasta, snapping spaghetti into short lengths, and simmer for 10 minutes until tender. Stir often so it doesn't stick, and add a splash of water if the soup gets too thick. Stir in the spinach for the final minute.

steps.title: Bake the bread
steps.text: While the pasta cooks, bake the baguette for 8 to 10 minutes (check the pack) until crisp and golden. Slice it just before serving.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Season the soup with salt and pepper and ladle into deep bowls. Scatter over the parmesan and serve with the warm bread.

title: Beef Lasagne with Silky Béchamel & a Golden Cheese Crust

steps.title: Prep the veg
steps.text: Finely dice the onion and carrot and finely chop the garlic. Grate the parmesan and tear the mozzarella. Dissolve the half stock cube in 150ml just-boiled water.

steps.title: Soften the veg
steps.text: Heat the oil in a large pan over a medium heat. Cook the onion and carrot for 8 min until soft, adding the garlic for the last minute.

steps.title: Brown the mince
steps.text: Turn the heat up to medium-high, add the mince and fry for 6–8 min, breaking it up, until browned all over. Stir in the tomato purée for 1 min.

steps.title: Simmer the ragù
steps.text: Add the chopped tomatoes, stock and herbs (optional) and bring to a bubble. Simmer over a low heat with the lid ajar for 30 min until thick. A spoon dragged through should leave a clear trail.

steps.title: Make the béchamel
steps.text: While the ragù simmers, melt the butter in a saucepan over a medium heat and stir in the flour for 1 min. Whisk in the milk a splash at a time until smooth, then simmer for 5 min, stirring, until it coats a spoon. Off the heat, stir in half the parmesan and season with salt and pepper. Heat the oven to 170°C fan.

steps.title: Layer up
steps.text: Spread a thin layer of béchamel in a small ovenproof dish (about 20 x 15cm), then add lasagne sheets, snapping them to fit. Spoon over a third of the ragù and a little béchamel, and repeat to make 3 layers. Finish with sheets covered in the remaining béchamel, then the mozzarella and the rest of the parmesan.

steps.title: Bake and rest
steps.text: Bake for 35–40 min until deep golden, bubbling at the edges and a knife slides easily through the pasta. Rest for 10 min before cutting so the layers hold together.

title: Creamy Lemon & Garlic Salmon Penne with Spinach & Peas

ingredients.swap: Cook the peas in a small pan of boiling water for 3 min and stir them into one portion only.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Put a large pan of salted water on to boil. Season the salmon with salt and pepper. Finely chop the garlic and grate the parmesan. Zest the lemon and cut it in half.

steps.title: Cook the salmon
steps.text: Heat the oil in a large non-stick frying pan over a medium-high heat. Cook the salmon skin-side down for 4 min until the skin is crisp, then flip and cook for 2–3 min more until it flakes easily. Lift out, remove the skin and break into big flakes.

steps.title: Cook pasta and peas
steps.text: While the salmon cooks, cook the penne according to the pack, adding the peas for the last 2 min. Save a mugful of the cooking water, then drain.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.text: Wipe out most of the fat from the salmon pan and set it over a medium-low heat. Add the garlic for 1 min, then the cream and lemon zest and bubble for 2 min until slightly thickened. Stir in the spinach until wilted.

steps.title: Toss and serve
steps.text: Add the pasta and peas, the parmesan, a squeeze of lemon juice and a splash of pasta water and toss until glossy. Gently fold through the salmon so it stays in chunks. Season with black pepper and serve.

title: Potato, Spinach & Feta Frittata with Tomato & Rocket Salad

ingredients.swap: Crumble the feta over one half of the frittata only before it goes under the grill.
Toss the tomatoes on their own and add the rocket to one plate only.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Slice the potatoes about 3mm thick, leaving the skins on. Slice the spring onions and halve the tomatoes. Beat the eggs in a jug with a good pinch of salt and pepper.

steps.title: Cook the potatoes
steps.text: Heat 1 tablespoon of the oil and the butter in a 20 to 24cm ovenproof non-stick frying pan over a medium heat. Add the potatoes, cover and cook for 10 to 12 minutes, turning now and then, until tender and golden at the edges.

steps.title: Wilt the spinach
steps.text: Add the spring onions for 1 minute, then the spinach a handful at a time until wilted. Spread everything out evenly across the pan.

steps.title: Set the frittata
steps.text: Heat the grill to high. Pour the eggs into the pan, tilting it to fill any gaps, then crumble over the feta. Cook over a low heat for 6 to 8 minutes without stirring until the edges are set but the top is still wobbly.

steps.title: Finish under the grill
steps.text: Slide the pan under the grill for 3 to 4 minutes until puffed, golden and just set in the middle. The handle will be very hot, so use an oven glove.

steps.title: Make salad and serve
steps.text: While it grills, toss the tomatoes and rocket with the remaining ½ tablespoon of oil and a pinch of salt. Rest the frittata for 2 minutes, then cut into wedges and serve with the salad.

title: Spinach & Ricotta Cannelloni with Golden Mozzarella

ingredients.swap: Leave the basil out of the sauce and scatter it over one half of the dish only.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Heat the oven to 180°C fan and boil a full kettle. Put the spinach in a colander in the sink. Crush 1 garlic clove and slice the other 2, grate the parmesan and tear the mozzarella.

steps.title: Make the filling
steps.text: Pour boiling water over the spinach to wilt it, then cool under the cold tap and squeeze out as much water as you can. Chop it and mix in a bowl with the ricotta, half the parmesan, the crushed garlic, salt and pepper. Re-boil the kettle.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.text: Heat the oil in a saucepan over a medium-low heat and cook the sliced garlic for 1 minute. Add the passata, a pinch of salt and half the basil, torn, and simmer for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Soften the sheets
steps.text: While the sauce simmers, lay the lasagne sheets in a roasting tin and cover with just-boiled water. Leave for 5 minutes until bendy, then lift out onto a clean tea towel.

steps.title: Roll the cannelloni
steps.text: Spread half the sauce over the base of a small ovenproof dish. Spoon a line of filling along the short edge of each sheet. Roll it into a tube and lay it seam-side down, packing them in snugly. Spoon over the remaining sauce so all the pasta is covered, as exposed edges go hard.

steps.title: Bake and serve
steps.text: Top with the mozzarella and the rest of the parmesan, then cover with foil and bake for 15 minutes. Uncover and bake for 15 to 20 minutes more until bubbling and golden and the pasta is tender when poked with a knife. Rest for 5 minutes and scatter with the remaining basil.

title: Sausage & Broccoli Orecchiette with Garlic, Chilli & Lemon

ingredients.swap: Leave the chilli out of the pan and sprinkle it over one plate only at the end.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Put a large pan of salted water on to boil. Squeeze the sausagemeat out of the skins. Cut the broccoli into small florets and thinly slice the stalk. Slice the garlic, grate the parmesan and zest the lemon.

steps.title: Fry the sausage
steps.text: Heat the oil in a large frying pan over a medium-high heat. Add the sausagemeat and fennel seeds (optional) and fry for 6–8 min, breaking it up with a wooden spoon, until golden and crisp.

steps.title: Cook pasta and broccoli
steps.text: While the sausage fries, cook the pasta according to the pack. Add the broccoli for the last 4 min so it's very tender.

steps.title: Bring it together
steps.text: Add the garlic and chilli (optional) to the sausage for 1 min. Scoop the pasta and broccoli into the frying pan with a ladle of the cooking water. Toss hard over a medium heat for 2 min, crushing some broccoli into a green sauce.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Take off the heat and add the parmesan, lemon zest and a squeeze of lemon juice. Toss until glossy and serve straight away.

title: Spiced Chicken Burrito Bowls with Rice & Beans

ingredients.swap: Char the sweetcorn on its own and spoon it onto one bowl only, then warm the beans separately.
Leave the tomatoes off one plate.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Rinse the rice in a sieve until the water runs clear. Cut the chicken into strips. Drain the beans, quarter the tomatoes and slice the avocado (optional).

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Put the rice in a saucepan with 300ml boiling water and a pinch of salt. Cover and cook on a low heat for 10 minutes. Turn off the heat and leave to steam, lid on, for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Cook the chicken
steps.text: While the rice cooks, heat the oil in a large frying pan over a medium-high heat. Fry the chicken for 6 to 7 minutes until golden. Sprinkle over the fajita seasoning and stir to coat, add a splash of water and cook for 2 minutes more until cooked through with no pink. Tip into a bowl.

steps.title: Char the corn and beans
steps.text: Put the pan back over a high heat. Cook the sweetcorn from frozen for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring now and then, until blackened in spots. Add the beans and toss for 2 minutes until hot.

steps.title: Build the bowls
steps.text: Fluff the rice with a fork and divide between bowls. Top with the corn and beans, chicken, tomatoes and avocado (optional), then finish with the soured cream.

title: Crispy Black Bean, Sweetcorn & Jalapeño Quesadillas

ingredients.swap: Leave the sweetcorn out of the filling and scatter it over one quesadilla only before you put the top wrap on.
Scatter the jalapeños over one quesadilla only, or serve them in a small bowl on the side.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Defrost the sweetcorn in a sieve under the hot tap and shake dry. Slice the spring onions, grate the cheddar and chop the jalapeños.

steps.title: Mix the filling
steps.text: Tip the drained beans into a bowl and roughly mash about half with a fork. Sprinkle over the fajita seasoning and stir to coat, then stir in the sweetcorn, spring onions and cheddar.

steps.title: Fill the quesadillas
steps.text: Spread the filling over two of the wraps, right to the edges. Scatter the jalapeños over the top. Lay the other two wraps on top and press down firmly.

steps.title: Fry until crisp
steps.text: Heat half the oil in a large frying pan over a medium heat. Cook one quesadilla for 2 to 3 minutes until golden underneath. Slide it onto a plate, flip it back into the pan and cook for 2 to 3 minutes more until the cheese melts. Repeat with the remaining oil and quesadilla.

steps.title: Slice and serve
steps.text: Cut each quesadilla into wedges and serve with the soured cream for dipping.

title: Crispy Pork Carnitas Tacos with Red Cabbage & Jalapeños

ingredients.swap: Leave the cabbage off one plate, or serve it on the side.
Serve the jalapeños in a small bowl on the side so they can be added to one portion only.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Cut the pork steaks into large 5cm chunks. Quarter the onion and bash the garlic cloves with the flat of a knife. Make up 400ml stock with the cube. Finely shred the red cabbage.

steps.title: Brown the pork
steps.text: Sprinkle over half the fajita seasoning and toss the pork to coat. Heat the oil in a casserole or deep lidded pan over a medium-high heat. Brown the pork for 5 minutes until golden all over.

steps.title: Braise until tender
steps.text: Add the onion, garlic and stock and bring to a simmer. Cover and cook on the lowest heat for 1 hour 15 minutes. It's ready when the pork falls apart when prodded with a fork.

steps.title: Shred the pork
steps.text: Heat the grill to high and line a baking tray with foil. Lift the pork out with a slotted spoon, shred with two forks and throw away the onion. Boil the pan liquid hard for 5 minutes until reduced to about 4 tablespoons. Stir in the rest of the fajita seasoning and toss through the pork.

steps.title: Crisp under the grill
steps.text: Spread the pork over the lined tray. Grill for 5 to 7 minutes, turning once, until the edges are crisp and caramelised.

steps.title: Load the tacos
steps.text: Warm the wraps in a dry frying pan over a medium heat for 20 seconds each side. Pile with red cabbage and crispy pork, then finish with soured cream and jalapeños.

title: One-Pot Cheesy Mexican Chicken & Rice Bake

ingredients.swap: Leave the sweetcorn out of the bake; microwave it for 2 minutes and stir it into one portion when serving.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Heat the oven to 180°C fan. Dice the chicken into bite-sized pieces. Chop the onion, dice the pepper and make up 250ml stock. Rinse the rice and grate the cheddar.

steps.title: Brown the chicken
steps.text: Heat the oil in a lidded ovenproof casserole over a medium-high heat. Fry the chicken for 5 minutes until golden all over. Add the onion and pepper and cook for 4 minutes until softening.

steps.title: Add the rice
steps.text: Sprinkle over the fajita seasoning and stir to coat for 1 minute. Add the rice and stir again. Pour in the chopped tomatoes, stock, drained beans and sweetcorn and bring to the boil.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Cover with the lid, or tightly with foil, and bake for 25 minutes until the rice is tender and has soaked up the liquid. Uncover, scatter over the cheddar and bake for 5 minutes more until melted and bubbling.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.text: Rest for 5 minutes so the rice settles. Spoon into bowls and top with soured cream.

title: Spiced Beef Kofta Meatballs with Feta & Lemony Couscous

ingredients.swap: Crumble the feta over one portion only, or serve it in a little bowl on the side.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Boil the kettle. Grate half the onion and finely chop the rest. Crush the garlic and zest the lemon.

steps.title: Shape and brown the meatballs
steps.text: In a bowl, mix the mince with the grated onion, one garlic clove, the cumin, half the cinnamon, the salt and pepper. Roll into 12 walnut-sized balls. Heat the oil in a large, deep frying pan over a medium-high heat and fry the meatballs for 6 to 8 minutes, turning, until browned all over; they'll finish cooking in the sauce. Lift onto a plate.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.text: Cook the chopped onion in the same pan over a medium heat for 5 minutes until soft. Stir in the remaining garlic and the rest of the cinnamon for 1 minute. Add the tomato purée, chopped tomatoes and 100ml water and bring to a simmer.

steps.title: Simmer the meatballs
steps.text: Return the meatballs, cover and cook for 12 to 15 minutes until cooked through and the sauce is thick. Stir in the spinach for the last 2 minutes until wilted.

steps.title: Make the lemony couscous
steps.text: While the meatballs simmer, put the couscous in a bowl with the lemon zest and a pinch of salt. Pour over 180ml boiling water and cover for 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork and add a squeeze of lemon juice.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Spoon the meatballs and sauce over the couscous and crumble over the feta.

title: Garlic Butter Chicken Kievs with Wedges & Broccoli

steps.title: Make the garlic butter
steps.text: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Mash the softened butter with the garlic and a pinch of salt. Shape it into a short log on cling film, wrap and freeze for 15 minutes. Cut the potatoes into wedges and the broccoli into florets.

steps.title: Roast the wedges
steps.text: Toss the wedges on a large baking tray with 1½ tablespoons of the oil and a pinch of salt. Spread out in one layer and roast on the top shelf for 40 to 45 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and crisp.

steps.title: Fill the chicken
steps.text: Lay each breast between two sheets of baking paper and bash with a rolling pin to an even 1cm thickness, avoiding thin spots. Put half the frozen butter in the middle of each, fold in the sides and roll up into a tight parcel. Sit seam-side down and freeze for 15 minutes to firm up.

steps.title: Coat the kievs
steps.text: Set out three plates: the flour seasoned with salt and pepper, the beaten egg, and the panko mixed with the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil. Roll each parcel in flour, then egg, then press firmly into the crumbs, covering the ends well. Put seam-side down on a lined baking tray.

steps.title: Bake the kievs
steps.text: Bake on the shelf below the wedges for 25 to 30 minutes until golden and the chicken is cooked through, with no pink in the middle. Rest for 3 minutes before serving, as the butter inside is very hot.

steps.title: Cook the broccoli and serve
steps.text: For the last 4 minutes, boil the broccoli in a pan of salted water over a high heat until just tender, then drain. Plate the kievs with the wedges and broccoli. Cut into the kiev at the table so the garlic butter spills out.

title: Gammon Steak, Fried Egg & Chunky Chips with Peas

ingredients.swap: Cook the peas in their own small pan and serve them on one plate only; cook the same amount of sweetcorn the same way for the other plate.

steps.title: Prep the chips
steps.text: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Cut the potatoes into thick chips (no need to peel), rinse and pat really dry with a clean tea towel. Snip through the fat on the gammon every 2cm so the steaks stay flat. Drain the pineapple (optional).

steps.title: Roast the chips
steps.text: Toss the chips on a large baking tray with 1½ tbsp oil and a good pinch of salt. Spread out in one layer and roast on the top shelf for 35–40 min, turning halfway, until golden and crisp.

steps.title: Fry the gammon
steps.text: When the chips have 12 min left, heat 1 tsp oil in a large frying pan over a medium-high heat. Fry the gammon for 4–5 min each side until golden at the edges and cooked through, with no pink juices. Add the pineapple (optional) for the last 2 min to caramelise, then move it all to a plate and cover with foil.

steps.title: Cook the peas
steps.text: While the gammon cooks, boil the peas in a small pan of water for 3 min until tender. Drain and stir through the butter and a pinch of pepper.

steps.title: Fry the eggs
steps.text: Wipe out the gammon pan and heat the remaining 1 tsp oil over a medium heat. Crack in the eggs and fry for 3–4 min until the whites are set and the edges are lacy. Season with pepper.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Pile the chips onto plates with a little salt and lay the gammon alongside. Top each steak with an egg and add the pineapple (optional) and peas. Gammon is salty, so taste before adding more salt.

title: Roast Pork with Crackling, Roasties & Apple Sauce

ingredients.t: 1 small crackling joint (about 700g); leftovers make great sandwiches
2 teaspoons for the rind, plus extra

steps.title: Prep the pork and veg
steps.text: Heat the oven to 240°C (220°C fan). Pat the pork rind really dry with kitchen paper. Peel and halve the potatoes, halve the carrots lengthways and cut the broccoli into florets. Halve the onion, and peel, core and chop the apples.

steps.title: Start the pork
steps.text: Rub the meat (not the rind) with 1 teaspoon of oil and a pinch of pepper. Rub the rind with 1 teaspoon of oil, then 2 teaspoons of salt, working it into the scores. Sit it rind-side up on the onion halves in a roasting tin and roast on the top shelf for 25 minutes, until the rind starts to bubble. Meanwhile, boil the potatoes in salted water for 8 minutes, drain, leave to steam for 2 minutes, then shake in the colander to rough up the edges.

steps.title: Roast low and slow
steps.text: Turn the oven down to 200°C (180°C fan) and pour 100 millilitres of water into the pork tin, keeping the rind dry. Heat the remaining oil in a second tray for 5 minutes, tip in the potatoes and carrots with a pinch of salt and turn to coat. Roast both for 45 to 50 minutes, turning the veg once, until the pork juices run clear when the thickest part is pierced.

steps.title: Rest and make the apple sauce
steps.text: Lift the pork onto a board and rest, uncovered, for 15 minutes (foil softens the crackling). Turn the oven up to 220°C (200°C fan) and give the potatoes and carrots 15 minutes more until crunchy. Meanwhile, put the apples, butter and 2 tablespoons of water in a small covered pan over a medium-low heat for 8 to 10 minutes until the apples collapse, then mash with a fork.

steps.title: Make the gravy and broccoli
steps.text: Spoon the fat off the pork tin, add 300 millilitres of boiling water and scrape up the sticky bits. Strain into a small saucepan, pressing the onion. Whisk in the gravy granules over a medium heat and simmer for 1 to 2 minutes until thick. At the same time, boil the broccoli in salted water for 4 minutes until just tender, then drain.

steps.title: Carve and serve
steps.text: Carve the pork into thick slices and break up the crackling. Serve with the roast potatoes, carrots, broccoli, apple sauce and gravy poured beside (not over) the crackling.

title: Steak & Ale Pie with Buttery Mash & Broccoli

ingredients.t: 4 tablespoons (3 for the mash, 1 to glaze)

steps.title: Brown the beef
steps.text: Chop the onion, cut the carrot into chunks and crush the garlic. Dissolve the stock cube in 200 millilitres of boiling water. Toss the beef with the flour and a pinch of salt and pepper. Heat the oil in a casserole or deep lidded pan over a high heat and brown the beef in two batches for 4 to 5 minutes each, until deep brown all over. Lift onto a plate.

steps.title: Simmer the filling
steps.text: Turn the heat to medium, add the onion and carrot and cook for 5 minutes. Stir in the garlic and tomato purée for 1 minute, then pour in the ale, scraping the bottom. Add the stock, Worcestershire sauce and beef. Cover and simmer over a low heat for 1½ hours, stirring now and then, until the beef is tender and the gravy coats a spoon.

steps.title: Top the pie
steps.text: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Spoon the filling into a small pie dish (about 1 litre) and leave to cool for 10 minutes. Brush the rim with milk, lay the pastry over, press the edges to seal and trim. Brush the top with milk and cut a small hole in the middle for steam.

steps.title: Bake the pie
steps.text: Put the pie on a baking tray and bake on the middle shelf for 25 to 30 minutes until puffed, deep golden and bubbling at the edges.

steps.title: Make the mash
steps.text: While the pie bakes, boil the potatoes in a large pan of salted water for 15 minutes until tender. Drain, leave to steam for 2 minutes, then mash with the butter, 3 tablespoons of milk and a pinch of salt until smooth.

steps.title: Cook the broccoli and serve
steps.text: For the last 4 minutes, boil the broccoli in salted water until just tender, then drain. Serve the pie with a big spoonful of mash, the broccoli and extra gravy from the dish.

title: Lancashire Hotpot with a Crispy Sliced Potato Top

ingredients.t: 1 lamb or beef cube in 350ml boiling water

steps.title: Prep the veg
steps.text: Heat the oven to 170°C (150°C fan). Slice the onions and carrot, and thinly slice the potatoes to about 3mm. Dissolve the stock cube in 350ml boiling water and melt the butter.

steps.title: Brown the lamb
steps.text: Toss the lamb with the mixed herbs, salt and pepper. Heat the oil in a flameproof casserole (or a frying pan) over a high heat. Brown the lamb for 4–5 min until coloured all over. Lift onto a plate.

steps.title: Make the gravy
steps.text: Turn the heat to medium and cook the onions and carrot for 8–10 min until soft and golden. Stir in the flour for 1 min, then gradually stir in the stock and Worcestershire until it thickens. Return the lamb and season.

steps.title: Layer the potatoes
steps.text: If you used a frying pan, tip everything into a small ovenproof dish (about 1 litre). Lay the potato slices over the top, overlapping like roof tiles. Brush with half the melted butter and season.

steps.title: Bake covered
steps.text: Cover with a lid or foil and bake on the middle shelf for 1 hour 15 min, until the lamb is tender.

steps.title: Crisp the top
steps.text: Uncover, brush the potatoes with the remaining butter and turn the oven up to 200°C (180°C fan). Bake for 35–40 min more until the top is golden and crisp at the edges and a knife slides easily through the potatoes.

steps.title: Cook the broccoli and serve
steps.text: For the last 4 min, boil the broccoli in salted water until just tender, then drain. Leave the hotpot to settle for a couple of minutes, then serve with the broccoli.

title: Honey-Garlic Lamb Chops with Buttery New Potatoes

steps.title: Prep everything
steps.text: Boil a full kettle and heat the grill to high. Halve any larger potatoes so they're all a similar size, and cut the broccoli into florets. Peel the garlic: halve one clove and crush the other. In a small bowl, mix the honey with the mixed herbs and a pinch of salt and pepper.

steps.title: Boil the potatoes
steps.text: Put the potatoes in a medium saucepan, cover with boiling water from the kettle and add a pinch of salt. Simmer over a medium-high heat for 15–18 min, until a knife slides in easily.

steps.title: Grill the lamb chops
steps.text: While the potatoes cook, rub the chops all over with the cut side of the halved garlic clove. Rub with the oil and season with salt and pepper. Grill on a rack for 3–4 min each side for pink, or 5 min each side for well done.

steps.title: Glaze and rest the lamb
steps.text: Brush the honey glaze over the chops and grill for a final 1 min, until sticky and golden at the edges. Move to a warm plate and rest for 3 min.

steps.title: Cook the broccoli
steps.text: When the potatoes have 4 min left, add the broccoli to the same pan. Cook until bright green and just tender.

steps.title: Butter the potatoes
steps.text: Drain the potatoes and broccoli well and return them to the pan off the heat. Add the butter, the crushed garlic and a pinch of salt and pepper. Toss gently until the butter melts and coats everything.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Pile the buttery potatoes and broccoli onto plates and add two chops each. Spoon over any resting juices and serve with the lemon wedges (optional).

title: Roast Sirloin of Beef with Yorkshires, Roasties & Gravy

steps.title: Prep and make the batter
steps.text: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan) and boil a full kettle. Peel the potatoes and cut into large chunks; cut the carrots into batons and the broccoli into florets. Take the steaks out of the fridge. Whisk the flour, egg and a pinch of salt in a jug, then whisk in the milk until smooth and leave to rest.

steps.title: Par-boil the potatoes
steps.text: Cover the potatoes with boiling water in a saucepan, add a pinch of salt and boil for 8 min. Meanwhile, put 2 tbsp oil in a roasting tin and heat in the oven for 5 min. Drain the potatoes, leave to steam for 2 min, then shake in the colander to rough up the edges.

steps.title: Roast the potatoes
steps.text: Carefully tip the potatoes into the hot oil and turn to coat. Season and roast on the middle shelf for 45–50 min, turning halfway, until golden and crisp.

steps.title: Sear and roast the beef
steps.text: When the potatoes have been in for 15 min, rub the steaks with 2 tsp oil, the coarse pepper and a pinch of salt. Sear in an ovenproof frying pan over a high heat for 1½ min each side, then hold the fat edge down for 30 sec. Roast in the oven for 6 min for medium-rare (8 min for medium). Rest on a board under foil for at least 15 min.

steps.title: Bake the Yorkshires
steps.text: Straight after the beef comes out, put ½ tsp oil into each of 4 holes of a muffin tin. Heat on the top shelf for 5 min, until smoking hot. Quickly pour in the batter and bake for 18–20 min, until puffed and deep golden. Don't open the oven door for the first 15 min.

steps.title: Cook the veg
steps.text: While the Yorkshires bake, boil the carrots in a pan of salted water over a medium-high heat for 4 min. Add the broccoli and cook for 4 min more, until both are just tender. Drain.

steps.title: Make the gravy
steps.text: Stir the gravy granules into 250ml boiling water from the kettle until smooth and thickened. Pour in any juices from the resting beef.

steps.title: Carve and serve
steps.text: Slice the beef thinly across the grain. Share it between plates with the roast potatoes, Yorkshires and veg, then pour over the hot gravy. Add a spoonful of mustard on the side (optional).

title: Chicken, Leek & Carrot Casserole with Garlic Mash

ingredients.t: 1 chicken stock cube in 400ml boiling water

steps.title: Prep everything
steps.text: Boil a full kettle and make up 400ml stock with the cube. Chop the onion, cut the carrots into thick rounds, and halve, rinse and slice the leek. Crush 1 garlic clove; peel the other 3 and leave whole. Halve the chicken thighs and season with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Brown the chicken
steps.text: Heat the oil in a large saucepan or casserole with a lid over a medium-high heat. Brown the chicken for 3–4 min each side until golden all over (it will finish cooking later). Lift onto a plate.

steps.title: Soften the veg
steps.text: Turn the heat to medium. Add the onion, carrots and leek to the pan and cook for 5 min, stirring, until starting to soften. Stir in the crushed garlic, tomato purée and mixed herbs for 1 min.

steps.title: Simmer the casserole
steps.text: Pour in the stock and Worcestershire sauce, scraping up the browned bits. Return the chicken and its juices and bring to the boil. Cover, turn the heat to low and simmer for 35 min, until the chicken is tender and the carrots are soft.

steps.title: Make the garlic mash
steps.text: While the casserole simmers, peel the potatoes and cut into even chunks. Boil with the 3 whole garlic cloves in salted water over a medium-high heat for 15–20 min, until soft. Drain, then mash the potatoes and garlic with the butter and milk until smooth. Season and keep covered.

steps.title: Thicken the gravy
steps.text: Mix the cornflour with 1 tbsp cold water until smooth. Stir it into the casserole and simmer uncovered for 3–5 min, until the gravy thickens enough to coat a spoon. Check a piece of chicken has no pink, then taste and season.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Spoon the garlic mash into shallow bowls. Ladle the chicken casserole and its gravy alongside.

title: Slow-Cooker Lamb Shanks with Rich Gravy & Mash

steps.title: Prep everything
steps.text: Boil the kettle and make up 450ml stock with the cube. Finely chop the onion, cut the carrots into small chunks and crush the garlic. Season the lamb shanks all over with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Brown the lamb
steps.text: Heat the oil in a large frying pan over a high heat. Brown the shanks for 8–10 min, turning, until well coloured on all sides. Move them into the slow cooker.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.text: Turn the heat under the same pan to medium. Cook the onion and carrots for 5 min, stirring, until softened, then add the garlic for 1 min. Stir in the stock, tomato purée, Worcestershire sauce and mixed herbs, scraping up the browned bits, and bring to a simmer. Pour over the lamb.

steps.title: Slow-cook the lamb
steps.text: Cover and cook on low for 7–8 hours, until the meat is meltingly tender and pulls away from the bone. No slow cooker? Cook in a lidded casserole in the oven at 180°C (160°C fan) for 3–3½ hours instead. Add a splash of water in the last hour if it looks dry.

steps.title: Make the mash
steps.text: About 30 min before the lamb is ready, peel the potatoes and cut into even chunks. Boil in salted water over a medium-high heat for 15–20 min, until soft. Drain, then mash with the butter and milk until smooth. Season and keep covered.

steps.title: Thicken the gravy
steps.text: Lift the shanks onto a plate and cover with foil. Pour the sauce and veg into a saucepan, stir in the honey and bring to a bubble over a medium heat. Mix the cornflour with 2 tbsp cold water, then whisk it in gradually and simmer for 2–3 min, until the gravy coats a spoon. Season.

steps.title: Cook the broccoli
steps.text: While the gravy bubbles, cook the broccoli in a pan of boiling salted water for 3–4 min, until just tender. Drain.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Spoon the mash onto warm plates and sit a lamb shank on top of each. Pour over plenty of gravy with its carrots and serve the broccoli on the side.

title: Pork & Apple Burgers with Cheddar & Crunchy Slaw

ingredients.swap: Leave the cabbage off one plate.
Leave the lettuce off one plate.

steps.title: Prep the veg
steps.text: Heat the grill to medium-high and line the grill pan with foil. Coarsely grate the apple (skin on) and the carrot. Finely shred the red cabbage.

steps.title: Shape the burgers
steps.text: In a bowl, mix the pork mince, grated apple, panko and Worcestershire sauce with a pinch of salt and pepper. With damp hands, shape into 2 patties about 2 centimetres thick and a little wider than the buns. Press a shallow dip in the middle of each so they stay flat. Chill for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Make the slaw and sauce
steps.text: While the burgers chill, mix 2 tablespoons of the mayonnaise with a pinch of salt in a bowl and toss in the red cabbage and carrot. In a small bowl, stir the rest of the mayonnaise with the mustard for the burgers.

steps.title: Grill the burgers
steps.text: Brush the patties with the oil and grill for 7 to 8 minutes on each side until golden. They are ready when there is no pink in the middle and the juices run clear.

steps.title: Melt the cheese
steps.text: Lay the cheddar over the burgers and grill for 1 minute until melted. Move them to a plate to rest. Toast the cut sides of the buns under the grill for 30 to 60 seconds, watching closely.

steps.title: Build and serve
steps.text: Spread the mustard mayo over the bun bases and add the little gem. Top with the cheesy burgers and the lids. Serve with the slaw on the side.

title: Sticky BBQ Ribs with Paprika Wedges & Slaw

ingredients.swap: Leave the cabbage off one plate.

steps.title: Rub the ribs
steps.text: Heat the oven to 150°C fan. Mix 2 teaspoons of the smoked paprika with 1 teaspoon of salt and a good grind of pepper. Pat the ribs dry and rub the mix all over, mostly on the meaty side.

steps.title: Slow-bake under foil
steps.text: Lay the ribs meaty-side up in a roasting tin and pour 100 millilitres of water around them. Cover tightly with foil, sealing the edges. Bake for 1 hour 30 minutes until the meat is tender and starting to pull back from the bones.

steps.title: Prep the wedges
steps.text: About 15 minutes before the ribs are ready, cut the potatoes into chunky wedges, skin on. Toss on a large baking tray with the oil, the remaining ½ teaspoon of paprika and a pinch of salt, and spread out in a single layer.

steps.title: Crisp the ribs and roast the wedges
steps.text: Take the ribs out and turn the oven up to 200°C fan. Move the ribs to a foil-lined baking tray and pour away the juices. Put the ribs on the top shelf for 10 minutes until the rub looks crusty. Put the wedges in below and roast for 35 to 40 minutes, turning halfway, until golden.

steps.title: Glaze the ribs
steps.text: Turn the ribs bony-side up, brush with a third of the BBQ sauce and roast for 10 minutes. Flip, brush with half the remaining sauce and roast for 10 minutes more. Brush on the last of the sauce and roast for 5 minutes until sticky and dark at the edges. Meanwhile, mix the mayonnaise with a pinch of salt and toss in the red cabbage and carrot for the slaw.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Rest the ribs for 5 minutes, then cut between the bones. Serve with the wedges and slaw.

title: Cheesy Tuna Melts with Sweetcorn & Crunchy Salad

ingredients.swap: Stir the sweetcorn into half the tuna mix only.
Make one portion of the salad without the lettuce, or serve the lettuce on the side.

steps.title: Get prepped
steps.text: Heat the grill to high. Put the sweetcorn in a sieve and pour over a kettle of boiling water to defrost it, then drain well. Grate the cheddar, chop the little gem and halve the tomatoes.

steps.title: Make the tuna mayo
steps.text: Drain the tuna well, pressing out the water with a fork. Mix with the mayonnaise, sweetcorn and a good grind of black pepper.

steps.title: Toast the bread
steps.text: Lay the bread on a baking tray and grill for 1 to 2 minutes until golden. Turn over, thinly butter the untoasted side and grill for 1 minute more.

steps.title: Grill the melts
steps.text: Spread the tuna mix over the buttered side, right to the edges. Pile the cheddar on top. Grill for 3 to 4 minutes until the cheese is bubbling and golden in patches.

steps.title: Dress the salad and serve
steps.text: While the melts grill, toss the little gem and tomatoes with the oil and a pinch of salt. Cut the melts in half and serve 2 slices each with the salad.

title: Sticky Prawn & Pak Choi Noodle Stir-Fry

ingredients.t: 3, sliced, whites and greens kept apart
ingredients.swap: Stir-fry the whites with the veg, but scatter the greens over one bowl only.

steps.title: Get prepped
steps.text: Put the kettle on. Sit the frozen prawns in a bowl of cold water for 10 minutes to defrost, then drain and pat dry. Slice the pepper and garlic, quarter the pak choi and slice the spring onions, keeping whites and greens apart. Mix the soy sauce and sweet chilli sauce in a small bowl.

steps.title: Cook the noodles
steps.text: Cook the noodles in a saucepan of boiling water for 4 minutes, or as the packet says, until just tender. Drain, rinse under cold water and toss with 1 teaspoon of the oil so they do not stick.

steps.title: Fry the prawns
steps.text: Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil in a wok or large frying pan over a high heat. Stir-fry the prawns for 2 to 3 minutes until pink all over. Tip onto a plate.

steps.title: Stir-fry the veg
steps.text: Add the pepper, garlic, ginger and spring onion whites to the wok and stir-fry for 2 minutes. Add the pak choi and cook for 2 minutes more until the leaves wilt but the stalks stay crisp.

steps.title: Toss it all together
steps.text: Return the prawns to the wok with the noodles and sauce. Toss over a high heat for 1 to 2 minutes until the noodles are glossy and piping hot.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Pile into bowls and scatter over the spring onion greens.

title: Crispy Chinese Lemon Chicken with Rice & Broccoli

ingredients.t: a pinch, plus a pinch for the rice

steps.title: Get prepped
steps.text: Put the kettle on. Slice each chicken breast in half horizontally to make 4 thin steaks, then season with a pinch of salt. Spread 40 grams of the cornflour on a plate. Dissolve the stock cube in 100 millilitres of boiling water and juice the lemons.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Rinse the rice and put it in a saucepan with 300 millilitres of boiling water and a pinch of salt. Bring back to the boil, cover and cook on the lowest heat for 12 minutes. Take off the heat and leave covered for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Make the lemon sauce
steps.text: Mix the remaining cornflour with a splash of the stock in a small saucepan until smooth. Stir in the rest of the stock, the lemon juice, honey and garlic. Simmer over a medium heat, stirring, for 2 to 3 minutes until glossy and the thickness of runny honey. Keep warm on the lowest heat.

steps.title: Fry the chicken
steps.text: Heat the oil in a large frying pan over a medium-high heat until a pinch of cornflour sizzles. Press the chicken into the cornflour to coat, shake off the excess and fry for 3 to 4 minutes each side until golden, crisp and cooked through with no pink. Drain on kitchen paper.

steps.title: Cook the broccoli
steps.text: While the chicken fries, cook the broccoli in a pan of boiling salted water for 3 to 4 minutes until just tender. Drain.

steps.title: Slice and serve
steps.text: Slice the chicken into strips and lay over the rice with the broccoli alongside. Spoon over the lemon sauce. Let the oil cool completely before binning it; never pour it down the sink.

title: Teriyaki Chicken Noodles with Broccoli & Spring Onion

ingredients.swap: Keep the sliced green tops back and scatter them over one portion only.
Sprinkle over one portion only at the table.

steps.title: Get prepped
steps.text: Boil the kettle. Slice the chicken into thin strips and cut the broccoli into small florets. Grate the garlic. Slice the spring onions, keeping the white and green parts separate.

steps.title: Mix the teriyaki sauce
steps.text: Stir the soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, garlic, ginger paste and 3 tbsp water together in a jug. In a cup, mix the cornflour with 1 tbsp cold water until smooth.

steps.title: Cook the noodles and broccoli
steps.text: Pour the boiled water into a large pan over a high heat. Add the broccoli for 2 min, then add the noodles for 4 min until both are tender. Drain and toss with the sesame oil.

steps.title: Fry the chicken
steps.text: Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over a medium-high heat. Fry the chicken for 5–6 min, turning, until golden and cooked through with no pink inside.

steps.title: Glaze the chicken
steps.text: Pour the teriyaki sauce into the pan and let it bubble for 1–2 min. Stir in the cornflour mix and cook for 1 min more, until thick, glossy and coating the chicken.

steps.title: Toss and serve
steps.text: Add the noodles, broccoli and white spring onion to the pan. Toss over the heat for 1–2 min until piping hot and coated. Serve topped with the green spring onion and chilli flakes (optional).

title: Chicken Ramen with Jammy Egg & Pak Choi

ingredients.swap: Scatter over one bowl only.
Sprinkle over one bowl only at the table.

steps.title: Get prepped
steps.text: Boil a full kettle. Finely chop the garlic and halve the pak choi lengthways. Cut the carrot into thin matchsticks and slice the spring onions.

steps.title: Boil the eggs
steps.text: Lower the eggs into a small pan of boiling water over a medium-high heat. Cook for 6½ min for jammy yolks. Cool them in cold water, then peel.

steps.title: Make the broth
steps.text: Melt the butter with the sesame oil in a large saucepan over a medium heat. Fry the garlic and ginger paste for 1 min without browning. Add 1 litre boiling water, the crumbled stock cubes, soy sauce and honey, and bring to a simmer.

steps.title: Poach the chicken
steps.text: Lower the whole chicken breasts into the broth. Cover and simmer gently for 12–14 min until cooked through with no pink inside. Lift onto a board and shred or slice.

steps.title: Cook the noodles and greens
steps.text: Add the noodles to the simmering broth for 2 min. Add the pak choi and carrot for a final 2 min until the stalks are just tender. Taste and add a splash more soy if needed.

steps.title: Build the bowls
steps.text: Use tongs to divide the noodles and veg between 2 deep bowls. Top with the chicken and ladle over the hot broth. Halve the eggs and sit them on top, then add spring onions and chilli flakes (optional).

title: Sticky Hoisin Beef Noodles with Peppers & Pak Choi

ingredients.swap: Scatter over one portion only.

steps.title: Get prepped
steps.text: Boil the kettle. Toss the beef with the cornflour and a pinch of salt. Slice the pepper, cut the carrot into matchsticks and quarter the pak choi. Grate the garlic and slice the spring onions.

steps.title: Mix the sauce
steps.text: Stir the hoisin, soy sauce, honey, garlic, ginger paste and 3 tbsp water together in a jug. Keep it by the hob, as the stir-fry is quick.

steps.title: Cook the noodles
steps.text: Cook the noodles in a pan of boiling water for 4 min until just tender. Drain, rinse under cold water and toss with the sesame oil so they don't stick.

steps.title: Sear the beef
steps.text: Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over a high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the beef in one layer for 2 min until browned. Lift onto a plate, as longer cooking makes it chewy.

steps.title: Fry the veg
steps.text: Add the pepper and carrot to the hot wok and stir-fry for 3 min. Add the pak choi for 1–2 min until the leaves wilt but the stalks stay crunchy.

steps.title: Toss and serve
steps.text: Return the beef to the wok with the noodles and sauce. Toss over a high heat for 1–2 min until sticky and piping hot. Serve topped with spring onions (optional).

title: Crispy Shredded Chicken in Honey-Chilli Sauce with Rice

ingredients.swap: Keep them out of the wok and scatter over one portion only.

steps.title: Get prepped
steps.text: Boil the kettle and rinse the rice. Cut the chicken into pencil-thin strips and toss with 1 tablespoon of the soy sauce and a third of the garlic. Slice the pepper, cut the carrot into matchsticks and cut the spring onions into short lengths.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Tip the rinsed rice into a small pan with 300 millilitres of boiling water and a pinch of salt. Cover and cook on the lowest heat for 10 minutes. Take off the heat and leave covered for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.

steps.title: Mix the sauce
steps.text: While the rice cooks, stir the remaining 2 tablespoons of soy sauce with the honey, rice vinegar and sweet chilli sauce in a small bowl.

steps.title: Coat and fry the chicken
steps.text: Toss the chicken strips in the cornflour until each one is dry and coated, then shake off the excess. Heat the oil in a wok or deep frying pan over a medium-high heat until a strip sizzles hard. Fry in 2 batches for 3 to 4 minutes until golden, crisp and cooked through. Drain on kitchen paper.

steps.title: Fry the veg
steps.text: Carefully pour off all but 1 tablespoon of the oil into a heatproof bowl (throw it away once cool). Stir-fry the remaining garlic, the pepper and carrot over a high heat for 1 to 2 minutes.

steps.title: Toss and serve
steps.text: Pour in the sauce and bubble for 30 seconds until syrupy. Add the chicken and spring onions and toss for 1 minute until coated. Serve on the rice.

title: Sweet Chilli Salmon Noodles with Stir-Fried Veg

steps.title: Get prepped
steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C fan and boil the kettle. Slice the pepper, cut the carrot into matchsticks, quarter the pak choi and grate the garlic. In a jug, mix 2 tablespoons of the sweet chilli sauce with the soy sauce, ginger paste and 3 tablespoons of water.

steps.title: Roast the salmon
steps.text: Put the salmon skin-side down on a lined baking tray and brush with 1 tablespoon of sweet chilli sauce. Roast for 12 to 15 minutes until it flakes easily and is opaque in the middle.

steps.title: Cook the noodles
steps.text: While the salmon roasts, cook the noodles in a pan of boiling water for 4 minutes until just tender. Drain and rinse under cold water.

steps.title: Stir-fry the veg
steps.text: Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over a medium-high heat. Stir-fry the pepper and carrot for 3 minutes. Add the garlic and pak choi for 1 to 2 minutes until the leaves wilt.

steps.title: Toss the noodles
steps.text: Pour the sauce into the wok and bubble for 1 minute. Add the noodles and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until coated and piping hot.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Divide the noodles between bowls and sit the salmon on top. Drizzle with the last tablespoon of sweet chilli sauce.

title: Vietnamese Chicken Pho with Rice Noodles

ingredients.swap: Dip them in the simmering broth in a sieve for 1 minute and add to one bowl only.
Scatter over one bowl only.

steps.title: Get prepped
steps.text: Boil a full kettle. Halve the onion, leaving the skin on. Slice the spring onions (optional) and cut the lime into wedges.

steps.title: Char the onion
steps.text: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over a high heat. Put the onion halves in cut-side down and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until blackened. Add the star anise for 30 seconds until fragrant.

steps.title: Simmer the broth
steps.text: Pour in 1.2 litres of boiling water and crumble in the stock cubes. Stir in the fish sauce, honey and ginger paste, then add the chicken. Bring to a gentle simmer, part-cover and cook for 25 minutes, skimming off any foam.

steps.title: Shred the chicken
steps.text: Lift the chicken onto a board and shred it with two forks. Fish the onion and star anise out of the broth with a slotted spoon. Taste and add a splash more fish sauce if needed.

steps.title: Cook the noodles
steps.text: Soak or boil the rice noodles in boiling water for 4 to 5 minutes (check the packet) until soft. Drain and rinse with hot water.

steps.title: Build the bowls
steps.text: Bring the broth back to a simmer and dip the beansprouts in for 1 minute. Divide the noodles, chicken and beansprouts between 2 deep bowls and ladle over the hot broth. Serve with lime wedges and spring onions (optional).

title: Crispy Bang Bang Chicken Noodles with Peanuts

ingredients.swap: Leave them out of the wok and sprinkle over one portion only.
Leave the sauce off one plate.

ingredients.t: a small handful, chopped, to serve

ingredients.swap: Scatter over one portion only.

steps.title: Get prepped
steps.text: Boil the kettle. Cut the chicken into strips about 2 centimetres wide, season with a pinch of salt and toss in the cornflour until coated. Slice the pepper and chop the courgette and garlic. Chop the peanuts and slice the spring onions (both optional).

steps.title: Mix the peanut sauce
steps.text: Whisk the peanut butter and sweet chilli sauce with 2 to 3 tablespoons of warm water until smooth.

steps.title: Fry the chicken
steps.text: Heat 3 tablespoons of the oil in a large frying pan over a medium-high heat. Fry the chicken in one layer for 6 to 8 minutes, turning, until golden, crisp and cooked through. Drain on kitchen paper.

steps.title: Cook the noodles
steps.text: Pour the boiled water into a pan and cook the noodles for 4 minutes until tender, then drain.

steps.title: Stir-fry the veg and noodles
steps.text: Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil in a wok over a high heat. Stir-fry the pepper and courgette for 4 to 5 minutes until charred in places. Add the garlic and chilli flakes for 1 minute, then the soy sauce and noodles, and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glossy and hot.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Pile the noodles into bowls and top with the crispy chicken. Drizzle over the peanut sauce and scatter with the peanuts and spring onions (optional).

title: Lamb Keema Curry with Spiced Potatoes & Warm Naan

ingredients.t: 1 chicken or lamb cube in 250ml water

steps.title: Prep the ingredients
steps.text: Boil the kettle. Cut the potato into small chunks, leaving the skin on. Finely chop the onion and grate the garlic. Crumble the stock cube into 250 millilitres of just-boiled water and stir.

steps.title: Brown the lamb
steps.text: Heat the oil in a large deep frying pan over a medium-high heat. Fry the lamb mince for 5 to 6 minutes, breaking it up with a wooden spoon, until browned all over. Spoon away most of the fat, leaving about 1 tablespoon in the pan.

steps.title: Add the onion and curry powder
steps.text: Turn the heat to medium. Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes until soft. Stir in the garlic, ginger paste and curry powder and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.

steps.title: Simmer with the potatoes
steps.text: Stir in the tomato purée, chopped tomatoes, potato and stock. Bring to a bubble, cover and simmer over a medium-low heat for 15 to 18 minutes, stirring now and then, until the potato is tender and the sauce is thick.

steps.title: Warm the naan
steps.text: While the keema finishes, heat a dry frying pan over a medium heat. Flick a few drops of water over each naan and warm for 1 minute each side until soft and lightly toasted. Wrap in a clean tea towel to keep warm.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Stir the spinach into the keema a handful at a time for 2 minutes until wilted, then season with salt. Serve with the warm naan and a spoonful of yogurt (optional).

title: One-Pot Chicken Pilau with Spinach & Cooling Raita

ingredients.swap: Make one portion of the raita without the cucumber, or serve the cucumber on the side.

steps.title: Prep the ingredients
steps.text: Boil the kettle. Rinse the rice in a sieve under cold water until it runs almost clear, then leave to drain. Thinly slice the onion, grate the carrot and garlic, and cut the chicken into chunks. Crumble the stock cube into 350 millilitres of just-boiled water.

steps.title: Brown the chicken
steps.text: Heat the oil in a wide saucepan or casserole with a tight-fitting lid over a medium-high heat. Season the chicken with a pinch of salt and fry for 4 to 5 minutes, turning, until golden on most sides. It will finish cooking with the rice.

steps.title: Cook the onion and spices
steps.text: Turn the heat to medium and add the butter, onion and carrot. Cook for 5 to 6 minutes, stirring, until the onion is soft and turning golden. Stir in the garlic, ginger paste, garam masala and turmeric for 1 minute until fragrant.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Stir in the drained rice until every grain is glossy and coated in spice. Pour in the hot stock, stir once and bring to the boil. Cover, turn the heat to low and cook for 12 minutes without lifting the lid.

steps.title: Make the raita
steps.text: While the rice cooks, finely dice the cucumber and stir it into the yogurt with a pinch of salt. Keep in the fridge until needed.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.text: Take the pan off the heat and leave it covered for 10 minutes. For the last 3 minutes, scatter the spinach on top and put the lid back on to wilt it. Fluff everything through with a fork and check the chicken is piping hot with no pink. Serve with the raita.

title: Cheesy Tuna & Sweetcorn Pasta Bake with Broccoli

ingredients.swap: Cook the sweetcorn in a small pan of boiling water for 3 minutes instead of with the pasta, and stir it into one half of the dish only before topping with cheese.

steps.title: Prep the ingredients
steps.text: Put a large pan of salted water on to boil and heat the grill to medium-high. Cut the broccoli into small florets, grate the cheddar and drain the tuna.

steps.title: Cook the pasta and veg
steps.text: Cook the penne as the packet says, adding the broccoli and sweetcorn for the last 3 minutes. Scoop out a small mugful of the cooking water, then drain everything in a colander.

steps.title: Make the cheese sauce
steps.text: While the pasta cooks, melt the butter in a medium saucepan over a medium heat. Stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute. Gradually whisk in the milk and simmer for 3 to 4 minutes, whisking, until thick enough to coat a spoon.

steps.title: Mix the bake
steps.text: Take the sauce off the heat and stir in two-thirds of the cheddar, the mustard and some salt and pepper. Fold in the pasta, veg and tuna, adding a splash of cooking water if it is stiff.

steps.title: Grill and serve
steps.text: Tip into a heatproof baking dish and scatter over the remaining cheddar. Grill for 5 to 6 minutes until golden and bubbling, then serve straight away.

title: Oven-Baked Chicken & Bacon Risotto with Spinach

steps.title: Prep the ingredients
steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan) and boil the kettle. Finely chop the onion and bacon and grate the garlic. Cut the chicken into 2cm chunks. Crumble the stock cube into 550ml just-boiled water.

steps.title: Brown the chicken and bacon
steps.text: Heat the oil in a wide ovenproof pan or casserole with a lid over a medium-high heat. Fry the chicken and bacon for 5 min, stirring, until golden. Add the onion, turn the heat to medium and cook for 4 min until soft.

steps.title: Toast the rice
steps.text: Stir in the garlic for 30 sec, then add the risotto rice. Stir for 1–2 min until the edges of the grains look see-through.

steps.title: Bake the risotto
steps.text: Pour in the hot stock, add a good grind of pepper and bring to the boil. Cover with the lid, or tightly with foil, and bake on the middle shelf for 20–22 min. It's ready when the rice is tender and most of the liquid has been absorbed.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Take the pan out and stir in the spinach for 1–2 min until wilted. Beat in the butter and most of the parmesan until creamy, adding a splash of hot water if it's thick. Check the chicken is cooked through, taste for salt, and serve with the rest of the parmesan and a squeeze of lemon (optional).

title: Tomato & Mozzarella Gnocchi Bake with Basil

ingredients.swap: Stir half the basil into the sauce as normal, and scatter the rest over one portion only at the end.

steps.title: Prep the ingredients
steps.text: Heat the grill to high and boil a full kettle. Crush the garlic and halve the cherry tomatoes. Tear the mozzarella into small pieces and pick the basil leaves.

steps.title: Make the tomato sauce
steps.text: Heat the oil in a large frying pan over a medium heat. Fry the garlic for 1 minute until fragrant but not brown. Add the passata, cherry tomatoes and half the basil, torn, then season. Simmer for 8 minutes until the tomatoes soften and the sauce thickens slightly.

steps.title: Cook the gnocchi
steps.text: While the sauce simmers, pour the kettle into a large saucepan over a high heat and add a pinch of salt. Cook the gnocchi for 2 to 3 minutes until they float to the top. Drain well.

steps.title: Combine in the dish
steps.text: Stir the spinach into the sauce for 1 minute until wilted. Fold in the drained gnocchi so every piece is coated. Tip into a medium ovenproof dish and spread out evenly.

steps.title: Grill until bubbling
steps.text: Scatter the mozzarella over the top. Grill for 5 to 7 minutes until the cheese is melted, bubbling and golden in patches.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Leave to stand for 2 minutes. Scatter over the remaining basil, then spoon into bowls.

title: Sausage & Mash with Gravy

steps.title: Bake the sausages
steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Put the sausages on a baking tray and bake for 25 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and cooked through.

steps.title: Boil the potatoes
steps.text: Meanwhile, put the potatoes in a pan of cold salted water, bring to the boil and simmer for 15 minutes until soft.

steps.title: Cook the veg
steps.text: Cook the frozen veg in a small pan of boiling water for 3 to 4 minutes, then drain.

steps.title: Mash and make the gravy
steps.text: Drain the potatoes and mash with the butter and milk. Make the gravy by stirring the granules into about 280 millilitres of boiling water from the kettle. Serve the sausages on the mash with the veg and plenty of gravy.

title: Steak Pie with Mash, Veg & Gravy

steps.title: Bake the pies
steps.text: Heat the oven following the pie packet, usually 200°C (180°C fan), and bake the whole pie for the time it says, usually 35 to 40 minutes, until golden and piping hot. Half is for tonight; the rest keeps in the fridge for lunch tomorrow.

steps.title: Boil the potatoes
steps.text: Meanwhile, put the potatoes in a pan of cold salted water, bring to the boil and simmer for 15 minutes until soft.

steps.title: Cook the veg
steps.text: Cook the frozen veg in a small pan of boiling water for 3 to 4 minutes, then drain.

steps.title: Mash and gravy
steps.text: Drain the potatoes and mash with the butter and milk. Stir the gravy granules into about 230 millilitres of boiling water from the kettle. Serve the pies with the mash, veg and gravy.

title: Southern Fried Chicken, Chips & Coleslaw

ingredients.swap: Leave the coleslaw off one plate.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Heat the oven following the chicken packet, usually 200°C (180°C fan). Bake the chicken and chips on separate trays for the times on their packets, usually 20 to 25 minutes, turning halfway.

steps.title: Sweetcorn
steps.text: Cook the sweetcorn in a small pan of boiling water for 3 minutes, then drain.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve the chicken and chips with the sweetcorn and coleslaw.

title: Easy Roast Chicken Dinner

steps.title: Roast potatoes in
steps.text: Heat the oven following the roast potato packet, usually 220°C (200°C fan). Spread the potatoes on a tray and bake for the time it says, usually 35 to 40 minutes, turning halfway.

steps.title: Warm the chicken
steps.text: Carve half the chicken into pieces, put it in a small dish, cover with foil and warm it in the oven for the last 15 minutes. Keep the rest of the chicken in the fridge for lunches.

steps.title: Yorkshires and veg
steps.text: Put the Yorkshire puddings in for the last 4 to 5 minutes. Cook the frozen veg in a pan of boiling water for 3 to 4 minutes, then drain.

steps.title: Gravy and serve
steps.text: Stir the gravy granules into about 280 millilitres of boiling water from the kettle. Serve everything with plenty of gravy.
